rv.q: Mowgli's departure from the jungle feels like a genuine loss, rounding off a gripping and vigorous show.
While the storytelling is uneven and the script could benefit from tightening up in places, there's plenty of fun to be had from the Octagon's colourful Christmas offering.
The cast give everything they have and there is much to recommend with this early contender for your festive theatre trip pounds.
Overall, I did not feel truly immersed enough to believe that I was watch animals not actors which led to disappointment in the end.
